minimum_pairs_rule: At least 100 paired speeches are required.
minimum_coverage_rule: At least half of a speaker’s speeches must find a match.
control_rule: Matched speeches hold year, agenda, and speaker group constant.
unmatched_rule: The whole-corpus comparison does not hold the debate constant.
reading_rule: Distinctive vocabulary is descriptive, not a claim about position.
self_reference_rule: Names are marked but never removed.
